svg.title: Велотренажёр интервалы — положение 2
svg.desc: Original ImageGen hollow contour, vector traced. Interval exercise on the same stationary gym exercise bicycle with fixed base and flywheel enclosure. LEFT seated relaxed recovery posture pedaling, right knee up. RIGHT seated harder effort with slightly lower torso and left knee up, both feet on opposite pedals, both hands on handlebars. No road wheels or motion effects. The two frames illustrate pedal positions. Work and recovery intensity and timing belong in the written instructions. Expert biomechanics approval pending.
